page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5i-c16g1.4xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance within the ecs.gn5i family, running on the KVM hypervisor. This instance features 16 dedicated physical CPU cores with a 1.0 thread-per-core configuration, providing 16 vCPUs without hyperthreading. The system is equipped with 64.0 GB of system memory, which translates to 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

For acceleration, the instance includes a single NVIDIA P4 GPU with 8 GB of dedicated VRAM. The instance does not feature any local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 3 Gbps, and the instance does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The dedicated CPU allocation and lack of hyperthreading ensure predictable compute performance, though the lack of local storage requires architectural planning for disk-heavy tasks. The inclusion of an NVIDIA P4 GPU makes this instance class suitable for entry-level GPU-accelerated workloads, such as small-scale machine learning inference, video transcoding, and basic parallel processing tasks, rather than high-end deep learning training.
